goal: Deliver native WGC screenshots with Automatic/WGC/GDI selection and startup-only GDI fallback, preserving the existing portable capture workflow. Video WGC, encoder expansion and hotkey recording remain subsequent tasks in TODO.md.
preserved_behavior: Tray-only startup, portable data, English/Russian UI and System/Contrast themes.
Live undimmed selection, fresh Enter/Ctrl+C capture, freeze only on screenshot-editor entry.
Screenshot capture needs no FFmpeg; clipboard, annotations, history and capture exclusion retain their contracts.
Physical multi-monitor coordinates, negative origins, portrait displays and desktop gaps.
Current gdigrab video/audio/pause/preview/edit/export remain unchanged in this stage.
Core remains net10.0 and contains no Windows SDK, Direct3D or WinRT dependency.
No native capture, GUI, audio or clipboard acceptance is run without separate user authorization.

tasks.name: Verify and pin WinRT/Direct3D build dependencies before implementing capture
tasks.description: Use standard net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0 targeting for Platform.Windows, App, App.Tests and Windows.Smoke; leave Core/Core.Tests net10.0. Pin the Windows SDK projection and Vortice.Direct3D11 3.8.3, inspect transitive runtime assets/licenses, and prove the projected WGC/Direct3D interop signatures compile and self-contained publish resolves every dependency. Do not run device creation, capability APIs or capture as part of feasibility checks. If dependency/API compatibility requires a different architecture or substantial dependency expansion, stop and revise this task before continuing. The Windows target is the existing Windows release host, not Linux runtime support.

phases.name: Persist capture preference and preserve fallback semantics

tasks.name: Add capture selection and a tested screenshot routing policy
tasks.description: Add CaptureBackend values Automatic, WindowsGraphicsCapture and Gdi, default Automatic for missing settings. Add a localized selector in Capture settings with explicit Stage1 help that the preference currently applies to screenshots and video still uses GDI. Preserve all unrelated JSON fields/options and validate unknown enum values. Implement screenshot routing behind IDesktopCapture: GDI bypasses WGC, strict WGC never silently substitutes, Automatic falls back only for typed WGC source-unavailable/initialization/first-frame-timeout failures. Cancellation, topology changes, invalid frames, allocation failures and export/clipboard errors are not blanket fallback conditions. Report effective method and reason through a bounded operation result/status callback without retaining pixel buffers or opening Settings.

phases.name: Acquire complete fresh desktop snapshots through WGC

tasks.name: Implement request-owned monitor capture and deterministic cleanup
tasks.description: Add a Windows-only WGC source. Resolve fresh HMONITOR handles by the same MONITORINFOEX.Device string stored in MonitorInfo.Id, never by FFmpeg index or PnP DeviceID. Check WGC support and validate current monitor bounds/scale against the request. Use request-owned frame pools/capture sessions and bounded GPU readback; explicitly set IsCursorCaptureEnabled=false before StartCapture. Copy valid ContentSize through staging textures while honoring row pitch; output checked, opaque BGRA bytes. Capture runs only for requested screenshots, never continuously from tray startup. Use a shared request deadline of5 seconds and reject stale/duplicate completion. Native bindings and monitor-session factory remain isolated from Core and injectable at the capture boundary for lifecycle tests.

new_abstractions.name: WindowsGraphicsDesktopCapture
new_abstractions.requirement: Supply native WGC frames through the existing screenshot contract

new_abstractions.name: WgcMonitorCapture
new_abstractions.requirement: Own framepool/session/GPU resources and provide a bounded fresh monitor frame

tests: Fake sessions verify cursor disabled before capture starts
Exactly one terminal result for frame/timeout/cancel races
Late callbacks during cleanup cannot access released framepool/device
Cancellation during readback releases the acquired frame only after copying stops
Initialization/partial construction failures dispose all owned native wrappers
Invalid dimensions/row pitch/content size are rejected
acceptance: No picker added to normal selection
No GPU/monitor capture API is executed by automated fake tests

tasks.name: Compose monitor frames without partial or misleading screenshots
inputs: Monitor physical bounds and frame timestamps
tasks.description: Assemble the same virtual desktop as GDI: negative origins, portrait dimensions, deterministic monitor order and opaque black gaps. Compare ContentSize to captured geometry and recheck monitor topology before publishing. All monitors must succeed. Frame timestamps must share the same clock, fall within the request freshness interval and have at most100ms inter-monitor skew; reacquire older frames within the shared5-second deadline, otherwise report acquisition timeout. This is bounded temporal consistency, not an atomic simultaneous desktop snapshot. Stage1 supports SDR WGC only: detect active advanced-color/HDR state without pixel sampling; HDR or indeterminate color capability is typed WGC-unavailable so Automatic can retain GDI and strict WGC explains the limitation. Do not ship an unchecked BGRA conversion as HDR tone mapping.

new_abstractions.name: WgcDesktopComposition
new_abstractions.requirement: Produce the existing virtual desktop pixel contract from independent monitor frames

new_abstractions.name: WindowsCaptureColorCapabilities
new_abstractions.requirement: Prevent silent washed-out HDR conversion in the SDR-only first stage

tests: Synthetic colored/padded frames prove negative-coordinate and portrait composition, row boundaries, alpha and black gaps

Timestamp skew/reacquisition obey shared deadline under a fake clock
HDR/unknown-color metadata selects eligible Auto fallback and actionable strict-mode failure
acceptance: DPI affects presentation only; composition uses physical pixels
Native multi-monitor/color behavior remains a user acceptance case
